summary.plain: An experiment in southern China that used clusters of detectors near and far from nuclear reactors to discover that one type of neutrino oscillation, long searched for, really happens.
summary.technical: Reactor-antineutrino oscillation experiment using up to eight functionally identical Gd-doped liquid-scintillator antineutrino detectors at near (470 m, 576 m) and far (1648 m) underground halls from six 2.9 GW_th reactor cores at the Daya Bay/Ling Ao nuclear power complex, Guangdong, China. Its 2012 result was the first observation of a non-zero theta_13 mixing angle via reactor antineutrino disappearance.
